title: DICT: Tight data security slows internet connectivity at Asean Summit

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Information and Communication Technology (DICT) has added layers of security to prevent information breach and pinpoint unknown threats during the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit here, according to officials on Saturday. But this led to slower internet connectivity for local and foreign media delegates stationed at the so-called International Media Center (IMC) at the World Trade Center in Pasay City days before the three-day summit with world leaders. “It is the security protocols that pass through different devices… Now, since we’re putting additional security protocols, it takes time.
